name: CreateTrigger

parameters.help_en: The role that the event source (such as OSS) uses to invoke the function. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53102.html
parameters.help_zh: 事件源（如OSS）调用函数所需的角色。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53102.html
parameters.name: invocation_role

parameters.help_en: The version or alias of the service
parameters.name: qualifier

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the trigger event source. This parameter can be ignored for timer, HTTP, and EventBridge triggers. This parameter is required for other trigger types. For EventBridge triggers, if you specify this field, an existing EventBridge resource is associated with the trigger. Do not configure the same sourceArn for two different EventBridge triggers. Otherwise, the update or delete operations of the triggers affect each other
parameters.help_zh: 触发器事件源的Aliyun Resource Name。对于定时、HTTP和EventBridge类型的触发器可忽略该参数，其它类型触发器该参数为必填项。对于 EB 触发器，若主动填写该字段，表示将 EB 侧已存在资源关联到该触发器，注意，两个不同 EB 触发器不要配置同一个 sourceArn，否则触发器的更新/删除操作会相互影响
parameters.name: source_arn

parameters.help_en:
The trigger configuration, which varies based on the trigger type. For the specific format, refer to the following data structures:

OSS trigger: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415697.html.
Log Service trigger: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415694.html.
Timer trigger: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415712.html.
HTTP trigger: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415685.html.
Tablestore trigger: You only need to specify the complete SourceArn parameter. No additional configuration is required here. Set the value to an empty object {}.
CDN event trigger: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415674.html.
MNS topic trigger: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415695.html.
EventBridge trigger: See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2508622.html
parameters.help_zh:
触发器配置，针对不同类型的触发器，配置有所不同。具体格式请参考如下对应的数据结构：

OSS触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415697.html。
日志服务触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415694.html。
定时触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415712.html。
HTTP触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415685.html。
Tablestore触发器：只需要填写完整的SourceArn参数便可, 这里无需额外配置，取值为空{}。
CDN事件触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415674.html。
MNS主题触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415695.html。
EventBridge触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2508622.html
parameters.name: trigger_config

parameters.help_en: The name of the trigger. The name can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name cannot start with a digit or hyphen (-). The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 触发器的名称。要求只能包含字母、数字、下划线(_)和短划线(-)。不能以数字、短划线(-)开头，长度限制为1~128个字符
parameters.name: trigger_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the trigger. Valid values:
oss: OSS trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62922.html.
log: Log Service trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84386.html.
timer: Timer trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68172.html.
http: HTTP trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71229.html.
tablestore: Tablestore trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100092.html.
cdn_events: CDN event trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73333.html.
mns_topic: MNS topic trigger. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97032.html.
eventbridge: EventBridge trigger
parameters.help_zh:
触发器的类型。具体取值和触发器类型对应关系如下所示：
oss：OSS触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62922.html。
log：日志服务触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84386.html。
timer：定时触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68172.html。
http：HTTP触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71229.html。
tablestore：Tablestore触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100092.html。
cdn_events：CDN事件触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73333.html。
mns_topic：MNS主题触发器。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97032.html。
eventbridge：EventBridge触发器
